verdict.rationale: Cooley GO publishes a public guidance hub with "actionable content for every stage of your business" and a free financing-data report. An independent HN comment confirms the site hosts FAQ-style posts on topics like allocating founder equity and equity-incentive tax issues, alongside its public formation and financing document pages. Missing for 10: detailed first-party evidence of the guidance library's scope, explicit evidence of plain-language explainers on formation and financing (beyond equity), and corroboration of how current the content is.
